description: Prophet prediction markets (tokenless): positions are kept as balances inside the AA instead of being issued as assets

field_descriptions.to: Address to credit the bought tokens or pay the reserve to
field_descriptions.type: Type of tokens to buy with the whole sent reserve: yes, no or draw
field_descriptions.yes_amount: Amount of YES tokens: positive to buy, negative to sell from your balance
field_descriptions.no_amount: Amount of NO tokens: positive to buy, negative to sell from your balance
field_descriptions.draw_amount: Amount of DRAW tokens: positive to buy, negative to sell from your balance
field_descriptions.min_expected_amount: Minimum amount to receive when buying by type, otherwise revert
field_descriptions.yes_amount_ratio: The share allocated to YES tokens on the first liquidity
field_descriptions.no_amount_ratio: The share allocated to NO tokens on the first liquidity
field_descriptions.claim_profit: Claim the winnings for the winning tokens on your balance, set to 1
field_descriptions.commit: Record the outcome of the event
